    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectItems" name="Select items">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ActivitiesSplitToPaymentSplit</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PaymentSplitToPay</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMethodToOrderJoin" sourceRef="Task_SetPaymentMethod" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivitiesSplitToPaymentSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_Activities_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSplitToPay" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_Pay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentSplitToInstallment" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Split" targetRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PayToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_Pay" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InstallmentToPaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_InstallmentAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMergeToActivitiesJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_Payment_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Activities_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseRewardToActivitiesJoin" sourceRef="Task_ChooseReward" targetRef="Gateway_Activities_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ActivitiesJoinToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Activities_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliveryMergeToDeliverItems" sourceRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge" targetRef="Task_DeliverItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeliverItemsToReturnSplit" sourceRef="Task_DeliverItems" targetRef="Gateway_Return_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplitToReturnItems" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="Task_ReturnItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${itemsReturned}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnSplitToEnd" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Return_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReturnItemsToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReturnItems" targetRef="Gateway_Delivery_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that an activity follows a previously described activity but is independent of the activities that come after it, and those later activities are performed concurrently with one another before a choice is made: Model the dependent activity as a branch that opens from the activity it follows, running in parallel with the independent concurrent activities. Do not place it in sequence between the join of the concurrent activities and the following decision. Close all branches with a parallel join before the decision that needs their results, so that the decision is not preceded by an unrelated gateway.
